name: cinema
description: Folder-based AI film project workflows for anybox for cinema.

shortDescription.zh-CN: 本地 AI 影视项目工作流。

longDescription.en-US: Initialize and operate local folder-based film projects for anybox for cinema. The plugin includes a project initialization skill and a local MCP server for reading Cinema project state and applying canvas commands through the Anybox Agent API.
longDescription.zh-CN: 初始化并操作基于本地文件夹的 anybox for cinema 影视项目。插件包含项目初始化 skill，并提供本地 MCP server，通过 Anybox Agent API 读取 Cinema 项目状态、执行 Canvas 命令。

defaultPrompt: Initialize this folder as an anybox for cinema project
Prepare a local cinema project structure
Repair the anybox for cinema project metadata in this folder

mcpServers.name: anybox for cinema
mcpServers.description: Read and update local anybox for cinema projects through the local Anybox Agent Cinema API.
permissions: Reads Cinema project summaries from the local Anybox Agent API.
Creates and updates Cinema canvas nodes, edges, and viewport state in initialized local Cinema projects after approval.
Writes Cinema command events to the local project's .anybox-cinema/events.jsonl file.

tools.name: cinema_get_project_summary
tools.title: Get Cinema Project Summary
tools.description: Read an initialized Cinema project's summary, node counts, recent events, directory overview, and gaps.

tools.name: cinema_apply_command
tools.title: Apply Cinema Command
tools.description: Apply a validated Cinema canvas command such as create-node, update-node, connect-nodes, or update-viewport.

tools.name: cinema_create_shot_plan
tools.title: Create Cinema Shot Plan
tools.description: Create Shot and Prompt nodes for a multi-shot plan and connect them on the Cinema canvas.

installReview: Runs a local Node.js MCP server bundled with the Cinema plugin.
Uses the local Anybox Agent Cinema API.
Canvas write actions are configured to ask before execution.

skillPreviews.name: Initialize Cinema Project
skillPreviews.description: Initialize, inspect, repair, or migrate an anybox for cinema local film project using only generic shell and file editing tools.
